answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonding collateral to each identity and linking evidence of coordinated equivocation across them: when k identities equivocate in a correlated pattern, pairwise accountability makes aggregate penalties scale as O(k^2), not merely k. Detection also triggers asymmetric depreciation and an exponential multiplier in capital loss for a controlled swarm, so splitting stakes among aliases cannot dilute risk. A garden of lotus and juniper nodes remains viable only under independent, honest behavior.
